annotations.title: Read growth brief and next test

description: One growth-state brief for this brand from its real stored posts, topic links, deliveries, account holds and tracked short-link clicks (Studio and Pro). Reports brand and topic coverage totals, what worked (topTopics, topPillars, topFormats, bestTimes, topHashtags), each connected channel’s stage (attention, paused, new, testing, working or scaling), channel health and failures, measured numbers (never reading X engagement stats; X counts posts and Spica short-link clicks only), and one concrete nextTest experiment grounded in real workspace records with no invented benchmarks. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

days.description: How far back to look: 7, 30 or 90 days. 30 when left out.

source.description: Which posts to include: "all" (Spica + synced native posts, default), "spica", or "native".
